# AniStream v2.0.1

- 🎉 Windows updates: New releases download in the background and install when you choose
  **Restart to update**. Each download is checked against the release's SHA-512 hash. Change this
  in **Settings → Updates**
- 🎉 Taste map: See your taste as a graph of what you've liked, grouped into named tastes, in
  **Settings → Customize app**
- ⚡️ For You: Picks you keep scrolling past fade out, sequels and next films get their own rows,
  and you can hide genres and tags you don't want to see
- ⚡️ Uses about half the memory at idle, and frees more when minimized
- ⚡️ Smaller install (about 37 MB less on disk) and less code to load at startup
- 🔒 The installed app can no longer be run as a plain Node.js process

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.0.1-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.0.1.exe`: Windows x64

Install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session are kept. This version has to be
installed by hand. From here on, Windows installs updates in the app. macOS keeps linking to the
release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Each download can be checked against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
